    "Model forecasts are consistently too low in the first 10-day horizon, showing significant undervaluation relative to true outcomes",
    "True outcomes exhibit stronger price recovery on days following sentiment declines, while model fails to capture this momentum",
    "Sentiment positive (>=0.67) correlates with above-model performance, suggesting model under-reacts to bullish sentiment signals",
    "Price levels in true outcomes are generally 0.1-0.3 higher than model forecasts at matching time horizons, indicating systematic overshoot/lag dynamic",
    "Model mean reversion to historical averages is too gradual; true prices revert faster and reach different equilibrium levels",
    "Sentiment turning negative predicts better than model performance, indicating model lacks proper sentiment response lag",
    "The gap between model and true outcomes widens in early forecast horizons (first 5-10 days) by up to 0.3-0.5"
